title: Branch Duo Standing Desk, Adjustable Standing Desk with 20" Range | OLED Control Panel, Frameless Design and Compact Size Suitable for Many Spaces, 36 Inches, Charcoal Base, Charcoal Top
features: INTRODUCING DUO: This height adjustable computer desk delivers ergonomic movement, intuitive features, and compact versatility. Its clean design and space-saving footprint make it a seamless fit for home offices, studios, and professional workspaces.

EFFORTLESS CONTROL: Adjust your desk height from 28" to 47.3" using the OLED control paddle, featuring two memory presets, sit-stand reminders, and collision detection. The 19.3" range supports smooth transitions and personalized comfort all day.

CLEAN, COMPACT DESIGN: The frameless structure provides more legroom and stability with less visual clutter. Rounded corners, a rear cable notch, and optional add-ons like a drawer or cable organizer help create a tidy and functional setup.

EASY SETUP & ACCESSORIES: Reusable threaded inserts make the electric stand up desk fast to assemble or disassemble. Pair with Branch accessories like a desk tray, or hook to personalize and organize your workspace.

DESIGN MEETS COMFORT: Praised for its sturdy construction and compact size, the Branch Duo Desk is ideal for small spaces like a home office or studio apartment, perfect for those who are trying to make the most of their small space.
